protocol.title: Keirin Chat continuity / capacity-proof operating protocol v1

current_research_objective: Reach scientific validation 100% primarily through historical virtual-world simulation. Three fixed-B1a 100-race batches are now complete, including a fully meeting-disjoint preregistered replication. Broad overall ranking performance is stable across 300 races, but venue-specific labels weakened on the fully independent meetings and exact 333.3m was not represented in the third batch. Next priority is coverage-balanced independent-meeting confirmation and immediate scale-up toward the existing ~2000-race substrate before final live confirmation.

retained_findings: Overall frozen-B1a ranking performance did not collapse across 300 races.
Exact circumference remains a required analysis dimension; no coercion is allowed.
Exact 333.3m remains a serious warning from the first two batches but was not represented in batch3.
Venue-specific strong/weak labels are not stable enough for operational adoption: Aomori weakened and Yahiko strengthened materially on fully disjoint meetings.
replication_comparison.important_negative_evidence: Do not tune away Toyama 0/16 exact-333.3m top1 from the temporal batch, and do not discard batch3 merely because it weakens earlier Aomori/Yahiko directional labels.

immutable_rule_summary: Historical virtual-world simulation is the primary path until final live confirmation (KR-016).
Offline simulation does not require live odds unless an experiment specifically tests odds.
Odds belong at live/manual purchase boundary.
Historical simulation uses PRE model fields only; target results/payouts are not predictor inputs.
Historical pages may be outcome-bearing; KR-015 prevents false prospective upgrades.
Exact circumference is preserved; no nearest-length coercion.
No guessed PRE fields, post-result cherry-picking, or confirmatory retune.
Venue/circumference subgroup findings require independent replication before operational adoption.
GitHub is canonical continuity state; chat is ephemeral.

exact_next_executable_actions: Preregister a new coverage-balanced independent-meeting confirmatory universe, explicitly requiring representation of the key exact-circumference/venue cells without using outcome-dependent replacement. This is a new experiment; do not modify or repair batch3 post hoc.
Execute the coverage-balanced confirmation with frozen B1a, no odds requirement, no retune, exact circumference and PRE/result separation.

In parallel or immediately after, expand toward the existing ~2000-race historical substrate and characterize class/grade, finals-vs-qualifiers, solo-rider and line-structure effects with all subgroup definitions frozen before scoring.

Only after ranking/probability stability is characterized, use historical odds/settlement data to optimize ticket count, minimum required odds and bankroll allocation; realtime remains final confirmation only.
progress_reason: Advanced from 93% because the preregistered fully meeting-disjoint 100-race replication completed 100/100 with zero prior-meeting overlap and broad overall B1a performance remained stable across a 300-race aggregate. Progress rises only one point because the deterministic third batch did not cover exact 333.3m/Kawasaki/Gifu/Toyama and weakened earlier venue labels, so subgroup stability and larger-scale ~2000-race characterization remain material unfinished science.
